items.name: Fighting Fish: Sashimi Trio, The Last Samurai, salmon avocado roll and seaweed salad (no edamame)
items.note: User ordered these four dishes, forgot the photo and explicitly requested estimates. Full portions consumed is an assumption, not measured or separately confirmed. High-side ingredient-based estimate; no official nutrition verified, no food photo, no external nutrition API data used. Menu composition source: https://www.fightingfishrva.com/s/PRINT-FF-Dinner-Menu-May-2026-3.pdf . Sashimi Trio is 3 tuna + 3 salmon + 3 yellowtail pieces; assume 25 g per piece (225 g raw fish total). Last Samurai: salmon, cucumber and avocado roll topped with yellowtail, avocado, tobiko and scallions; no mayo/tempura listed, so none added to estimate. Assumed 180 g seasoned cooked rice, 50 g salmon, 50 g yellowtail, 70 g avocado across filling/topping, 30 g cucumber/scallions, 10 g tobiko, 2 g nori. Classic roll: 140 g seasoned cooked rice, 50 g salmon, 40 g avocado, 2 g nori. Seaweed salad: 130 g dressed serving, including sweetened sesame/oil dressing; dressing not counted again. No edamame; no unreported drinks or additional sauces included. Generic independent working nutrition per 100 g (kcal/P/F/C): tuna 130/29/0.6/0; salmon 208/20/13/0; yellowtail 146/23/5.2/0; seasoned cooked rice 150/2.5/0.3/34; avocado 160/2/14.7/8.5; cucumber/scallions 20/1/0/4; tobiko 140/22/6/2; nori 300/40/4/40; dressed seaweed salad 115.4/2.3/5.4/14.6. These are approximate generic ingredient assumptions, not restaurant measurements or newly retrieved database records. Calories and macros calculated independently, with component grams rounded to 0.1; precision is arithmetic, not measurement certainty.
